actions.action: Isolate the plant from other plants
Remove mostly brown leaves with clean scissors and bag them
Dab each visible mealybug with a cotton swab dipped in 70% isopropyl alcohol, every 3 days for 3 weeks
Slide plant out of pot and check roots for white cottony masses
If roots are infested, rinse them under lukewarm water and repot in fresh mix
Spray whole plant weekly with insecticidal soap, including leaf undersides

reason: It identifies a sap-sucking pest infestation, a close match to the confirmed whiteflies or similar bugs, and its core fix of wiping the bugs off with alcohol and removing badly damaged leaves matches what worked; its advice to stop whole-plant alcohol spraying differs from the thread but is not likely to harm the plant.
